environment: Organization: a freelance full-stack developer building a real-estate agency website (Next.js 16 + Convex) for a client. Primary use of Claude Code: software development on this single project.
Host containment: the developer's own Windows workstation. This is an unattended overnight build that works only inside this project folder; the developer reviews all commits in the morning.

Key internal services: this project's own Convex DEV deployment (named by CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT in .env.local; hosts *.convex.cloud and *.convex.site). Pushing functions/schema with `npx convex dev --once`, running functions with `npx convex run`, importing seed data, listing env var names and setting app environment variables with `npx convex env set` on this dev deployment are routine parts of the task. Production deploys are NOT part of the task.

Trusted package registries: the public npm registry (registry.npmjs.org). Installing npm packages into this project and running well-known npx CLIs (shadcn, convex, playwright, next, lighthouse) is routine development work for this task.

Trusted internal domains (read-only public assets used by the site): tiles.openfreemap.org, images.unsplash.com, dl.polyhaven.org, api.polyhaven.org, d28zzqy0iyovbz.cloudfront.net, sparkjs.dev, nominatim.openstreetmap.org.
allow: Installing project dependencies with npm/npx and downloading the Playwright Chromium browser via `npx playwright install chromium` is allowed.
Setting application environment variables on this project's own Convex DEV deployment is allowed (never production).
Deleting or overwriting create-next-app boilerplate files (public/*.svg, the default app/page.tsx and app/layout.tsx) is allowed; they are tracked in git.
Downloading public demo assets listed in docs/assets/demo-media.json (Unsplash photos, Poly Haven CC0 panoramas, CC-BY splat scenes) into this project is allowed.
Starting and stopping local dev/prod servers (next dev, next start) and Playwright tests on localhost is allowed.
